parse_instruction_folders: parse LLM-generated instruction folders and validate objects exist in scene info
parse_instructions: parse a single folder of LLM-generated episodes and verify object validity
episode_init_valid: validate an episode initialization against scene info checking for missing objects and furniture
parse_to_json: parse malformed JSON strings from LLM output into valid JSON lists
load_scene_info: load scene information from a JSON file and extract all furniture and rooms
